verdict.rationale: The docs show Devin implementing new features in its own cloud VM with a shell, browser and full repo access, where it keeps working after you close your laptop. Environments boot preconfigured and Devin builds and tests across platforms, including Android, iOS/macOS and Windows. Auto-Fix iterates on CI failures and review comments, and computer use lets it click through UIs and take screenshots, which supports showing the working feature. Hands-on community reports note extraneous changes and sessions stuck in loops, which lowers confidence but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: an explicit demo artifact such as a recorded walkthrough or preview link for reviewers, and independent corroboration of successful end-to-end feature delivery.
